title: MoveNet is detector evidence, not the skeleton definition
plainLanguage: MoveNet gives 17 detected body points. Corpus Pane’s universal skeleton is richer because it also has derived/manual head, neck, chest, pelvis, hands, toes, and the five-slot face.
purpose: Keep the detector replaceable and prevent model topology from becoming the product schema.

rules.statement: Map MoveNet keypoints into universal skeleton IDs; do not rename the universal skeleton to match a detector.
Label derived controls as derived/manual rather than pretending they were detected.
A future detector may add more evidence without requiring a new anatomical language.

implementation.currentSupport: This detector-to-universal pattern is already present in the current system.
implementation.futureWork: Keep any future detector adapters behind the same universal schema.
